verdict.rationale: Atlassian documents product sandboxes for Jira as isolated replicas of production where changes can be tested safely before reaching production. Forge also provisions free demo development sites for building and testing apps, so a user can test without touching production data. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that sandboxes work as described, explicit documentation of agent/API access against sandboxes, and availability on all plans (sandboxes require Premium or Enterprise and carry no SLA).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: A sandbox is an isolated environment where you can experiment and test changes safely before applying them in production.
Every sandbox works like a replica of your production environment
Forge can provision a demo development site when you need an Atlassian site for developing and testing an app
